rationale: Round 4 surfaced a genuinely new and consequential fissure — Works Council/Union declaring the board veto is unconditional regardless of audit findings, which forced Management, State, Family Holding, and Investors to explicitly recalibrate their positions and demand a direct answer on the ratchet/tightening question. This is substantive movement, not mere process agreement, and key questions (dividend magnitude, ratchet reversibility, threshold definitions) remain live and untested, so further rounds are likely to change the picture.
